# Findable

Findable is an SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) agency helping local, D2C, and e-commerce brands get found on Google, cited by AI engines, and chosen by customers.

- https://TODO_DOMAIN/services/aeo: Answer Engine Optimization for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and Google AI Overviews.
- https://TODO_DOMAIN/services/geo: Generative Engine Optimization for AI citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini.
